title: Title & Registration Services Extension Tags: Stretching the Waiting Allowances on the Last Extension
content:
On a Title & Registration Services order, the waiting allowances added on top of an extension tag's base validity are first added together, and that sum is then stretched when the new tag is the last extension that the lower of the service's limit and the registration state's maximum extensions allows: when the state has returned the order at least once, the sum is multiplied by 1.25 (one and a quarter) and the product is rounded up to the next whole day, in the buyer's favour; when the state has never returned it, the sum is multiplied by 1.1 (one and a tenth) and the product is rounded down to a whole day; when further extensions remain, the sum is taken as it is.

## When the new tag is the last extension

The extension limit is the lower of Kestrel's own extension limit for the service type and the registration state's maximum extensions below. The new tag is the last extension when the temporary tags already issued on the order, the original included, number at least that limit.

| Registration state | AZ | TX | GA | FL | NC | OH | PA | CO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| State maximum extensions | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 |

Returns are counted as all state rejection entries on the title order, whatever their reason.

## Decision table

| New tag is the last extension | State has returned the order | Sum of the waiting allowances |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least once | multiplied by 1.25, rounded up to the next whole day |
| yes | never | multiplied by 1.1, rounded down to a whole day |
| no | either | taken as it is |

## Worked examples (hypothetical, allowances summing to 13 days)

- GA order, service limit 2, original tag and one extension already issued (two tags): the new tag is the last extension. Returned once: 13 multiplied by 1.25 is 16.25, rounded up to 17. Never returned: 13 multiplied by 1.1 is 14.3, rounded down to 14.
- CO order, service limit 3, original tag only (one tag): the limit is 2, so further extensions remain and the sum stays 13.
